$comment: Canned replies for the stand-in platform (demo/fake-platform.js in the case desk engine), so this desk can be tried with no platform. Each key is a distinctive part of a case title, matched without regard to case. The stand-in adds its own first line saying that the reply is canned. The replies follow the right answers in demo-bank/SCENARIOS.md for the bank date 2026-11-24. The bank, the exchange, the companies and their filings are invented. Start the stand-in with DESK_CONFIG pointing at desk.config.json in this folder.
